name: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the World's Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Heart of the Wood

system.description:
One of a pair of Lithuanian Sielanic Thaumaturgical Paths developed by the Telyavelic Tremere bloodline, drawing on the Siela — the animistic spirit latent in earth, stone, plant, and animal. Telyavelic Tremere always learn one of the two Sielanic Paths as their primary Thaumaturgical Path; other Tremere may learn either Path only by studying with a Telyavelic Tremere, and non-Tremere thaumaturges may do so only if they already know Thaumaturgy and can convince a Telyavelic teacher to share it. The Path vanishes with the Telyavelic bloodline's extinction, though a handful of 20th-century Lithuanian Cainites attempt to reconstruct it from incomplete records amid the country's pagan revival. This Path lets its caster partake of the abilities inherent in a plot of ground to which she has attuned herself (see the ritual One With the Land), most often her home territory.

The vampire seeks refuge within the living wood of a tree standing inside her area of attunement, concealing her presence from enemies; her aura blends with the tree's, making her harder to detect through supernatural senses. While within the tree she may use any Disciplines and abilities that don't depend on physical gestures or eye contact, and she is protected from the sun so long as she remains inside. If the tree is felled she takes damage and is ejected; burning the tree does the same, but with fire's aggravated harm.

System: The vampire drinks the blood-and-sap mixture and spends blood; successes determine how long she may remain within the tree, from a single turn up to a full 24 hours, after which the tree ejects her.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the World's Blood)
system.bloodCost: Blood mixed with tree sap, plus 1 Blood Trait
